data.title: Senior Motion Designer:in (m/w/d)
data.description:
re:mood ist eine Kölner Crew aus kreativen Köpfen, Produzent:innen, Kamera-Nerds, Editor:innen und Veranstaltungstechniker:innen. Wir verbinden zwei Welten: Die High-End Ästhetik einer Filmproduktion mit der Energie von Live-Events.

Um unsere visuellen Welten auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir zur Erweiterung unseres kreativen Teams dich als Senior Motion Designer:in (m/w/d)). Im Zentrum deiner Arbeit steht der Einsatz von KI: Du entwickelst und designst mit KI-Tools und prägst, wie wir sie in unseren Produktionen nutzen.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen einer 40-Stunden-Woche bist du der kreative Motor für unsere bewegten Bilder und kümmerst dich um folgende Aufgaben:

  • Kreation & Animation: Du erstellst hochwertige 2D- und 3D-Animationen, Motion Graphics und visuelle Effekte – sowohl für erstklassige Film- und Videoproduktionen als auch für großflächige Live-Event-Bespielungen (LED-Wände, Projektionen).
  • Planung & Konzeption: Du begleitest den kompletten kreativen Prozess – von der ersten Idee über Storyboards und Styleframes bis hin zum finalen Render.
  • KI-gestützte Produktion: Du arbeitest täglich mit KI-Tools, entwickelst und designst damit und baust unsere KI-Workflows weiter aus.
  • Teamplay: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Editor:innen, Produzent:innen und Videotechniker:innen, um sicherzustellen, dass deine Visuals perfekt in das Gesamtkonzept und auf unsere Bühnensetups passen.
  • Asset-Management: Du bereitest Grafiken und Videos mediengerecht auf und hast dabei ein Auge auf komplexe Formate, Auflösungen und Playback-Systeme (z.B. Pixera als Medienserver).
  • Qualitätssicherung: Du stellst sicher, dass unser Output immer dem visuellen „re:mood“-Goldstandard entspricht.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Motion Design, Mediendesign (oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation) ODER bringst als talentierte:r Quereinsteiger:in fundierte Berufserfahrung und ein beeindruckendes Portfolio/Showreel mit. Zudem hast du mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Motion Design. Als Senior führst du Projekte eigenverantwortlich von der Idee bis zum finalen Render.
  • Software-Expertise: Cinema 4D oder Blender, Adobe Creative Cloud (insbesondere After Effects, Illustrator und Photoshop) ist dein zweites Zuhause. Erfahrungen mit Unreal Engine oder Notch sind ein großer Pluspunkt!
  • KI-Erfahrung: Du arbeitest sicher mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video und Animation und kennst ihre Stärken und Grenzen im Produktionsalltag.
  • Leidenschaft: Du hast ein hervorragendes Gespür für Ästhetik, Timing, Typografie und visuelles Storytelling. Du brennst dafür, große Projekte qualitativ hochwertig umzusetzen.
  • Flexibilität: Kreativität kennt keinen 9-to-5-Rhythmus. Auch wenn wir Wert auf geregelte Zeiten legen, bringst du die in der Branche übliche Einsatzbereitschaft mit.

Benefits

  • Top Equipment: Arbeite mit leistungsstarken Workstations und der besten Software in einem professionellen Umfeld.
  • Spannende Projekte: Du bist maßgeblich an großen High-End Medienproduktionen beteiligt und siehst deine Arbeit auf den ganz großen Screens.
  • Verantwortung: Wir schätzen deinen Input – du hast die kreative Freiheit, Projekte aktiv mitzugestalten und deinen eigenen Style einzubringen.
  • Home-Office: Im Bereich Postproduktion und Design lässt sich vieles flexibel gestalten. Nach Absprache kannst du deine Aufgaben bequem aus dem Home-Office erledigen.
  • Remote Work: Remote Work ist möglich.
  • Sport und Gesundheit: Wir legen Wert auf Bewegung und gewähren dir einen Zuschuss auf ein Fitnessstudio-Abo oder eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.
  • Mobilität: Für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg bieten wir dir ein Job-Ticket an.

Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden und mit uns hochwertigen Event- und Social Media Content produzieren?

Dann freue wir uns auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung.

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
data.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d), you act as the electrical core of our robotics engineering team, taking complete ownership of our hardware platforms from early prototyping through to series production. You bridge high-speed autonomous robotic development with robust engineering processes, ensuring our hardware meets the highest quality and safety standards, and set up efficient systems and engineering gates that empower the broader team to work with clarity, focus, and speed.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the full electrical picture: Design and execute schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, cable harness design, connector selection, and part specification.

  • Drive end-to-end prototyping and series production: Build PCBs, circuits, and wiring systems, taking dynamic initial concepts all the way through to scalable manufacturing.

  • Establish engineering processes: Build standard QA frameworks, engineering gates, and operational systems that allow the team to stay focused, execute rapidly, and succeed.

  • Ensure quality, compliance, and safety: Act as the primary gatekeeper for electrical quality while navigating applicable industry safety standards and regulatory compliance.

  • Engine for high-speed execution: Balance fast-paced autonomous robotic iteration with pragmatic, right-sized QA processes tailored to current development stages.

  • Design motion system architectures: Develop and optimize 24V/48V power distribution, motor/servo drive integration, and sensor interfaces to ensure high signal integrity and thermal efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with firmware and software teams on board bring-up, microcontroller integration, and system-level debugging.

  • Manage DFM/DFT and supplier relationships: Work directly with contract manufacturers and in-house assembly teams to oversee BOM costs, component sourcing, and engineering change control.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field.

  • Several years of experience in full-cycle electrical design (analog, digital, and power circuits) across multiple companies, taking products from concept to market.

  • Deep technical background in Altium, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32), motion systems (24/48V power, motor drives, encoders, sensor interfaces), and EMC/thermal layout strategies.

  • Solid grasp of DFM/DFT principles, cable harness design, signal integrity, and direct collaboration with contract manufacturers.

  • Proactive, end-to-end ownership mindset with a pragmatic working style and a drive to establish scalable processes in a high-growth environment.

  • Very good English skills (German is a plus).

  • Nice to have: Familiarity with industrial protocols (EtherCAT, Profinet, Modbus, CAN, Ethernet) and exposure to relevant standards/safety concepts (CE/Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, EMC standards, STO, PL/SIL).

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

data.title: Fincrime Analyst (Relocation to Luxembourg)
data.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office.

About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

 

What you'll be doing

As our Fincrime Analyst, you’ll be the person who leads the surveillance, identification, and containment of real-time fraudulent and illicit activities across our ecosystem. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • High-Volume Alert Review & Resolution – Managing, analyzing, and resolving transaction monitoring alerts flagged by our systems, ensuring swift and accurate decision-making on complex or ambiguous customer behaviors.

  • Advanced Escalation Handling – Serving as the primary point of contact for complex alerts escalated by other teams, conducting the necessary deep dives to quickly determine if further investigation or filing is required.

  • Detection Logic Feedback Loop – Translating insights gained from your daily alert reviews into actionable feedback for Product and Data teams to help tune, refine, and update our transaction monitoring rules.

  • Process & Workflow Optimization – Identifying bottlenecks in the daily alert handling queue and proposing tactical improvements to streamline workflows, reduce false positives, and increase team efficiency.

  • Mentorship on the Line – Coaching and onboarding junior analysts by sharing best practices on transaction analysis, pattern recognition, and effective case documentation.

  • Compliance & Airtight Documentation – Ensuring every resolved alert is backed by clear, concise, and defensible rationale that strictly adheres to regulatory standards and internal guidelines.

Revenue Operations Associate

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Das Team

Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du verantwortest den Angebotsprozess und erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie.

  • Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern.

  • CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen

  • Vertragsmanagement: Du prüfst Verträge für unsere Großkund:innen und stellst sicher, dass unser Vertragswerk passgenau zu ihren Anforderungen passt.

  • Vertriebsstrategie und Planung: Du unterstützt bei Pipeline-Reviews, Forecasts sowie bei der allgemeinen vertrieblichen Steuerung.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen.

  • Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten.

data.title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
data.description:
At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation.

  • Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness.

  • Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions.

  • Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. 

  • Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture.

  • Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions.

  • Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments.

  • Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness.

  • Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle.

  • Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities.

  • Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices.

  • Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team.



What you bring to the team:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems.

  • Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python.

  • Experience developing embedded software in C/C++.

  • Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including:

    • Perception

    • State estimation

    • Sensor fusion

    • Motion planning

    • Feedback control

  • Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2.

  • Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors.

  • Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV.

  • Experience implementing real-time control systems.

  • Experience with machine learning for robotic perception.

  • Experience with Linux-based embedded systems.

  • Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics.

  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a Growth-focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.
